title: Alignment Services & Plans Terms — Holdings per Customer and per Vehicle
content:
## Terms for holding Alignment Services & Plans

**1. Holdings per customer.** A customer may hold any number of Alignment Services & Plans holdings — alignment services and alignment plans — one per vehicle the customer owns; there is no limit on the number of holdings per customer. A plan is valid only on the vehicle it was bought for. Plans of different vehicles never share alignments, intervals or refunds.

**2. How many holdings one vehicle may carry.** That question is governed by the one-holding-per-vehicle term of this product, not by the number of holdings the customer has.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer owns three vehicles and holds an alignment plan on each. Each plan counts only the alignments performed on its own vehicle, measures its interval only from its own vehicle's alignments, and refunds only its own price on cancellation; an alignment performed on one vehicle never uses up or restarts the interval of another vehicle's plan.

| Question | Answer under these terms |
|---|---|
| May one customer hold plans on several vehicles? | Yes — any number, one per vehicle owned |
| Is a plan valid on a vehicle other than the one it was bought for? | No |
| Do two vehicles' plans share alignments, intervals or refunds? | No |
